provenance: Real NASA FIRMS standard processing rows (Country Yearly Summary files; MODIS version labels 6.2 for 2000 to 2017, 6.03 for 2018 to 2022 and 61.03 for 2023 to 2025; VIIRS version 2), counted inside the region's context box. Not simulated.

harmonization_method.description: Suomi NPP equivalent rows = MODIS rows (Terra plus Aqua) x the place's ratio for that month of the year x a factor for the size of the month's MODIS count. The month's ratio leans on the place's ratio over the year, which leans on its surroundings and its latitude band; a month in which MODIS saw nothing gets the place's mean Suomi NPP count in such months. Terra alone, fitted the same way, before Aqua

interval.what: the 10th to 90th percentile of held-out errors of predictions of about the same size, from every overlap year left out in turn over every place of the fit

fitted_on.held_out: each overlap year 2012 to 2025 left out in turn over every place at once

fitted_on.prior: surroundings: the box grown to [147.0, -35.75, 153.75, -29.75], from the fire cube, less the place's rows

harmonization_method.counted_rows: every FIRMS row except type 2 (static land source, counted as static_excluded) and type 3 (offshore) rows on sea or within 500 m of it in the region's context DEM (counted as offshore_on_sea_excluded); type 3 rows farther inland, such as fire beside mountain lakes, count
harmonization_method.outage_rule: a day inside a platform's operating span on which it has no row in any cached country file while the other platforms together have at least 100

platforms_counted_not_fitted.NOAA-20: counted from 2018-04 in raw_counts; the fit stays Suomi NPP over MODIS, one platform pair through the whole 2012 to 2025 overlap
platforms_counted_not_fitted.NOAA-21: counted from 2023-03 in raw_counts, from area API rows of the region box (no outage check possible); not in the fit, for the same reason

harmonization_method.not_in_calendar: 2026: its rows come from the area API for the region box only (no country-wide count to tell an outage from a quiet day), and its near real time rows have no type column, so static sources cannot be left out; the calendar ends at the last country file month instead

validation.nominal_interval: 80 percent: the 10th to 90th percentile of held-out errors of predictions of about the same size, per latitude band
validation.definition: for each overlap year but a closed one: the method is fitted on the other overlap years and predicts that year's Suomi NPP count of every clean month from its MODIS count; relative error = (predicted - observed) / observed over the year; coverage = share of held-out years (annual) or months (monthly) whose observed Suomi NPP count lies inside the interval
validation.interval_note: the interval checked here is the one in use, whose table holds held-out errors of every year in other places, and the world factors of the pooled method are fitted on every year; the coverage measured on years that did not set the table is in docs/harmonization.md

ratio_stability.rule: each held-out year (the served method fitted on the other overlap years) is tested when Suomi NPP's rows or the prediction reach 50 over the clean months, and departs when the two differ by more than 10 times; not stable when 2 tested years or more depart

harmonization_method.replaced_only_by: a method that beats it on held-out overlap years

real_run_starts.rule: a start date is worth showing when the 24 MODIS overpasses after it span at most 192 h, begin within 24 h of the start, and flag at least 100 pixels in the region box
real_run_starts.chosen_from: MODIS rows only; no VIIRS row is read to choose, drop or rank a start
real_run_starts.hidden_counts: none: the list carries MODIS counts only; what the hidden satellite saw in a window comes with that run's reveal
real_run_starts.search: months from 2012 whose region box holds at least 100 MODIS rows; 17 months searched
real_run_starts.closed_starts: none of these starts is closed
real_run_starts.default_rule: the start with the most MODIS pixels in the box, because the model gives no default for this region
